guide.inShort: The platinum pops on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned. Treat it as a checklist audit, not a task.

steps.text: Work the roadmap in stage order so story, counts and activities finish together.
Use the ledger counters for every target trophy and reconcile them weekly.
When one trophy remains, earn it and wait — the platinum unlocks automatically.

guide.inShort: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It teaches movement, driving and the partner switch.

steps.text: Play the prologue at default settings and follow every on-screen prompt.
The trophy unlocks as the mission complete screen appears.

guide.inShort: Finish every Chapter 1 story mission. Nothing here can be skipped permanently.

steps.text: Follow the chapter markers on the map until the chapter card plays.
The trophy unlocks at the end of the chapter finale.

guide.inShort: Finish Chapter 2. The wanted system gets teeth here, so learn safehouse routes early.

steps.text: Complete each Chapter 2 mission as it unlocks on the map.
The trophy unlocks when the chapter closes.

guide.inShort: Finish Chapter 3, the point where Vice City fully opens up.

steps.text: Clear the Chapter 3 mission chain in order.
The trophy unlocks at the chapter end card.

guide.inShort: Finish Chapter 4 and the story moves into its endgame setup.

steps.text: Complete all Chapter 4 missions; side strands can wait until after.
The trophy unlocks as Chapter 4 concludes.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

guide.inShort: Finish the final story mission. Keep a manual save before the point of no return so ending-adjacent trophies stay reachable.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save before starting the finale.
Stock armour, snacks and your best weapons before the last marker.
Complete the final mission; the gold unlocks at the credits roll.

guide.inShort: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in Chapter 2.

steps.text: Pick up the Breakfast Run marker during Chapter 2.
Complete the delivery under fire; the trophy pops at mission complete.

guide.inShort: Finish The Cartel Heist story mission. Any approach works; the trophy only cares about completion.

steps.text: Run the heist setup missions as they unlock.
Finish the heist finale; the trophy unlocks on escape.

guide.inShort: Finish the story mission Child's Play.

steps.text: Start Child's Play from its story marker in Chapter 2.
Complete the mission; the trophy unlocks at the wrap-up.

guide.inShort: Finish the story mission Headliners in Chapter 3.

steps.text: Take the Headliners marker when it appears in Chapter 3.
Play it through; the trophy pops at mission complete.

guide.inShort: Finish VCIA Takedown at the airport. A fast car staged nearby makes the escape leg trivial.

steps.text: Start VCIA Takedown from its Chapter 3 marker.
Complete the takedown and escape; the trophy unlocks at mission complete.

guide.inShort: Finish Operation Savage Glory, a late-story set piece. Bring your strongest loadout.

steps.text: Restock armour and ammo before the operation marker.
Complete the operation; the trophy unlocks at the debrief.

guide.inShort: Reach 100 percent on the in-game completion checklist. The story alone is not enough — strands, activities and collectibles all count.

steps.text: Finish the story, then open the completion checklist and work category by category.
Clear all stranger strands and one of each activity type.
Sweep collectibles with the ledger counters so nothing is left at 98 percent.
The gold unlocks the moment the checklist reads 100 percent.

guide.inShort: Land 250 stunts. Marked stunt jumps are the reliable route; natural air off ramps and dunes also counts when the game registers it.

steps.text: Use a fast bike or light car and work stunt spots region by region.
Land cleanly on wheels — a crash voids the stunt.
Track progress with the counter here; repeat your fastest loop for the tail.
The silver unlocks at stunt 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.

guide.inShort: Sample all nine activity types once. You do not need to win — starting and finishing each type is enough.

steps.text: Open the activities list and note the nine types.
Play one session of each as they unlock across the map.
The trophy unlocks when the ninth type is tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

guide.inShort: Gold-medal every Shooting Range challenge. Learn each course layout first, then chase the score with accuracy over speed.

steps.text: Run each challenge once to learn target order before scoring attempts.
Prioritise headshots and streak bonuses; restart instantly after a miss streak.
Gold the courses weapon class by weapon class.
The silver unlocks when the final course turns gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

guide.inShort: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Practice laps teach the gates; winning once per location is enough.

steps.text: Fly each course once slowly to learn the gate line.
Race again and take the win; cut corners only where the gates allow.
The trophy unlocks after the 14th location win.

guide.inShort: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not add to the count.

steps.text: Enter races from the map and log each win in the counter here.
Use a tuned car in its class; clean lines beat risky overtakes.
The trophy unlocks at your 20th distinct race win.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

guide.inShort: Beat Cal in his fishing challenge. Match bait to the spot and keep tension steady on the reel-in.

steps.text: Accept Cal's fishing challenge at his spot.
Land the heavier total catch before time expires.
The trophy unlocks when Cal concedes the challenge.

guide.inShort: Finish any one arcade game, start to credits. Pick the shortest cabinet you find.

steps.text: Find an arcade cabinet in any bar or arcade interior.
If the cabinet needs tokens, buy them at the counter first so the run is not interrupted.
Play one full game to completion; quitting early does not count.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.

guide.inShort: Finish Andy's whole strand, through his final mission. Strands unlock in order, so keep returning when his icon reappears.

steps.text: Complete each Andy mission as his marker appears.
Finish his final mission; the trophy unlocks at the strand end.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

guide.inShort: Finish Kenton's strand through its final mission, out on the water.

steps.text: Work Kenton's missions in order as they unlock.
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops at the strand close.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.

guide.inShort: Finish Billy's strand through his final mission.

steps.text: Complete Billy's missions in strand order.
Finish the final mission; the trophy unlocks at the end.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

guide.inShort: Complete eight full stranger strands anywhere in Leonida. Individual missions do not count — a strand must be finished.

steps.text: Pick strands near your story route first: Andy, Kenton and Billy all count.
Return whenever a strand icon reappears; strands progress in stages.
Log each finished strand in the counter here.
The silver unlocks when the eighth strand closes.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.

guide.inShort: Finish Randy's strand through its final mission.

steps.text: Complete Randy's missions as his marker cycles back.
Finish his final mission; the trophy unlocks at strand end.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

guide.inShort: Finish Tyrone's strand through its final mission.

steps.text: Work Tyrone's missions in order.
Complete the final mission; the trophy pops at the close.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

guide.inShort: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. They sit on beaches, rooftops and overlooks — visit each once and complete the short prompt.

steps.text: Sweep the spots region by region using the world map.
Interact and stay until the meditation completes.
The trophy unlocks at the 18th spot.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

guide.inShort: Take Bret's hunt and bring down the unique animal he names. Track it at dawn when spawns are most reliable.

steps.text: Accept the hunt from Bret and note the target animal.
Track and hunt the unique animal in its habitat.
Return to Bret; the trophy unlocks on delivery.

guide.inShort: Complete any three full collectible card sets. Focus one set at a time so the last cards do not scatter across the whole map.

steps.text: Pick the three shortest sets and sweep them region by region.
Cards glow at close range; check rooftops and interiors, not just streets.
Log each finished set in the counter here.
The silver unlocks when the third set completes.

guide.inShort: Use the WAiNK It spot at 100 different locations. Each location counts once, so keep moving rather than repeating a favourite.

steps.text: Use every new WAiNK spot you pass during story play.
Sweep the remaining spots district by district in free roam.
Track the count here; the silver unlocks at location 100.

guide.inShort: Complete any 50 challenges from the challenges menu. Short repeatable ones are the fastest filler once the story set is done.

steps.text: Open the challenges list and pin the shortest ones first.
Batch challenges by area so travel time stays low.
The trophy unlocks at challenge 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner present and free-roam access together; story stretches where the pair is separated cannot progress it. Do it during an open chapter rather than leaving it for the endgame.

guide.inShort: With your partner alongside, earn a 4-star wanted level, then lose it completely and escape.

steps.text: Commit crimes in free roam with your partner present until you reach 4 stars.
Break line of sight, swap vehicles away from patrols and wait out the search.
The trophy unlocks when the wanted level clears fully.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: The chain breaks if the wanted level drops between shops, and it needs your partner with you. Pick three shops on one street so travel never lets the heat fade.

guide.inShort: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive the whole chain.

steps.text: Scout three shops close together on one route.
Rob the first, keep police attention, and drive straight to the second.
Rob the third before the wanted level drops; the trophy pops on completion.

guide.inShort: Discover 100 different vehicles — entering a new model registers it. Rich districts and the airport are dense with variety.

steps.text: Jack or enter every new model you see during normal play.
Sweep parking lots in wealthy areas for the rare tail.
The trophy unlocks at vehicle 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

guide.inShort: Drop five enemies inside one Combat Focus activation. Set it up in a crowded firefight rather than hoping for it in the open world.

steps.text: Start a gang operation or late mission with clustered enemies.
Trigger Combat Focus with a full magazine and pre-aimed targets.
Down five before the effect ends; the trophy pops on the fifth.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: Guides link the departure to the airport sequence around VCIA Takedown; if that window is the only trigger, finishing the mission without departing loses it for the playthrough. Keep a save before the mission.

guide.inShort: At VCIA airport, leave in a way the schedule never planned — take an aircraft or vehicle out outside any mission script.

steps.text: Save manually before the VCIA Takedown mission.
At the airport, break from the script and take off in an unscheduled aircraft.
The trophy unlocks as you depart the airport grounds.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableNote: The description is a joke with no verb, so the exact trigger is unconfirmed. Community reading points at the Rhino tank; treat any tank encounter as the attempt and keep a save first.

guide.inShort: The vague one: everything points at the Rhino tank. Get into, or survive, a Rhino encounter and see the pop.

steps.text: Raise a maximum wanted level near military presence or find a Rhino in free roam.
Engage the Rhino — enter it if the prompt appears, otherwise survive its attack up close.
If it does not pop, reload and retry the other reading; guides still disagree.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableNote: Detection fails the attempt, not the trophy — but stores may stay alarmed for a while after a botched try. Enter clean, leave clean, and retry at a different store if one burns.

guide.inShort: Rob a jewelry store with zero detection: no alarms, no witnesses calling it in, in and out unseen.

steps.text: Scope a jewelry store at night and note staff and camera positions.
Enter masked, control the room quietly and take the goods without an alarm.
Leave on foot to a stashed car two streets away; the trophy pops once clear.

guide.inShort: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. A robbery only counts once you have lost the heat with the money.

steps.text: Case a bank, stage a fast car one block away, then hit the vault.
Escape fully before starting the next bank — overlapping heat muddies the count.
Log each clean vault in the counter here.
The silver unlocks after the fifth escape.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

guide.inShort: Stop an armored truck, take its cargo and escape the response.

steps.text: Block the truck with a heavy vehicle on a quiet stretch.
Breach the rear doors, grab the cash and switch cars to break the trail.
The trophy unlocks once you escape with the take.

guide.inShort: Visit all 52 named areas of Leonida. Most reveal naturally through the story; the tail is islands and rural pockets.

steps.text: Let story travel reveal the urban areas first.
Sweep greyed map regions by boat and plane for islands and coast.
The trophy unlocks when the final area reveals.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

guide.inShort: Rob one illegal operation from each of the nine gangs. Variety is the requirement — nine hits on one gang counts once.

steps.text: Identify each gang's territory and mark one operation per gang.
Hit one operation per gang and log it in the counter.
The trophy unlocks after the ninth gang is robbed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: Reads like an early-game Ocean Beach moment. If the prompt only exists before the story moves inland, it is gone until a new playthrough — try it in the first hours to be safe.

guide.inShort: Have a cocktail at a beachfront spot on Ocean Beach with the sea in view. Do it early, in the first hours.

steps.text: Head to the Ocean Beach strip in the first hours of the game.
Order a cocktail at a beachfront bar and take the seat with the view.
The trophy unlocks as the drink moment completes.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

guide.inShort: Get into a car inside a vehicle showroom and drive it straight out through the glass.

steps.text: Enter a vehicle showroom and pick the display car nearest the window.
Drive it through the showroom glass to the street.
The trophy unlocks as you exit the showroom.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

guide.inShort: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete the follow-through — play the bowling moment the location offers.

steps.text: Travel to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start the bowling activity and complete a full game or its scripted moment.
The trophy unlocks at the alley when the follow-through lands.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: The description hides a partner moment, so it likely sits inside a specific story or hangout window. Keep partner hangouts current late in the story instead of rushing the finale.

guide.inShort: A deliberately vague partner trophy. The working reading: complete the standout partner activity the story spotlights late on.

steps.text: Keep up with partner hangouts and optional partner scenes as they appear.
Complete the spotlighted partner activity when the story offers it.
The trophy unlocks at the end of that shared moment.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Guides report the tracker counting choices toward 500, but which interactions qualify is unconfirmed. Make dialogue and world choices whenever offered and the count should take care of itself.

guide.inShort: Make choices — the tracker reportedly counts them to 500. Dialogue picks and world decisions all appear to feed it.

steps.text: Never skip a dialogue choice; pick an option every time one is offered.
Take optional decisions in missions instead of letting timers expire.
Track the reported count here; the trophy unlocks at 500 choices.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: Reads as fail-once-then-succeed on the same attemptable event. If the qualifying event is a one-time story moment, a first-try success could pass it by — sources disagree, so keep a save before big set pieces.

guide.inShort: Fail at something, then succeed at the same thing on the retry. Deliberately manufacture it somewhere cheap and repeatable.

steps.text: Pick a cheap repeatable attempt — an arcade game or a short race.
Fail it once on purpose, then immediately retry and succeed.
The trophy unlocks on the successful second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: A strange-event trophy with no confirmed trigger. Rural and swamp areas at night are the community's best guess; nothing yet proves the event is missable or repeatable.

guide.inShort: Witness something strange. The community reading points to a scripted oddity event out in the wilds — explore off-road at night.

steps.text: Roam rural Leonida and the swamps after dark, away from missions.
Investigate any unusual lights, sounds or encounters until the event triggers.
The trophy unlocks when the strange event plays out.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missableNote: The melee drive-by mechanic itself is barely documented, so the exact input is unconfirmed. Try it on a quiet sidewalk group where a failed attempt costs nothing.

guide.inShort: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee attack delivered from a moving vehicle — a drive-by, but with fists or a melee weapon.

steps.text: Equip a melee weapon and take a slow car or bike along a busy sidewalk.
Use the vehicle melee attack while passing a pedestrian and connect cleanly.
The trophy unlocks when the pedestrian goes down from the hit.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

guide.inShort: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Robberies feed the supply; laundering is a separate hand-off.

steps.text: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and heist side takes.
Hand bills to your laundering contacts whenever you pass one.
Track the laundered total here; the trophy unlocks at $250,000.

guide.inShort: Spend a cumulative $100,000 in shops. Vehicles, weapons and property-adjacent spending sprees in the endgame close this fast.

steps.text: Buy weapons, ammo, clothing and vehicle mods as you play — it all counts.
In the endgame, outfit both characters fully to burn the remainder.
The trophy unlocks when lifetime shop spend passes $100,000.

guide.inShort: Buy all eight garage properties across Leonida. Save heist payouts for the expensive end of the list.

steps.text: Buy garages as funds allow, cheapest districts first.
Use heist and laundering income for the pricey final garages.
The trophy unlocks when the eighth garage is purchased.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

guide.inShort: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Any vehicles you own or keep can be registered from the app screen.

steps.text: Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone.
Register vehicles you own until the list reaches ten.
The trophy unlocks at the tenth registration.
